info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Corporate Relation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Relations Management API enables businesses to update existing corporate relationship details using specific parameters. This operation primarily focuses on modifying essential information related to corporate partnerships, enhancing accuracy and relevance in financial transactions. Ideal for financial institutions and corporate clients, this API supports the dynamic management of corporate relations and ensures alignment with organizational changes. Developers can utilize this API to maintain up-to-date relationships, facilitating smoother interactions and enhanced service delivery.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific corporate relationship identified by its resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to reflect the updates you wish to apply.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the corporate relationship identified by the specified resource ID (RES-100045). It includes all necessary fields required for the modification of the relationship data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the resource has been updated.
